propositions: Canonical contributor guidance in AGENTS.md and .agents/rules/rebar.md prescribes a hardcoded bot identity (joeoakhart+bot@navapbc.com) for DCO sign-off instead of instructing contributors to use their own configured git identity.
CONTRIBUTING.md requires contributors to sign off with their real configured identity, creating a contradiction with agent guidance that names a specific third-party bot identity.

General contributor-facing documentation (AGENTS.md, .agents/rules/*.md, docs/**/*.md) must be made identity-neutral and must consistently instruct use of git config user.name and user.email, with Joe Oakhart's bot identity retained only in automation-owned paths (infra/, .github/workflows/, tests/fixtures/, docs/experiments/).

A deterministic make lint-integrated consistency check must be implemented to prevent reintroduction of hardcoded personal sign-off strings in contributor-facing guidance files, using git grep with path exclusions to exempt automation-owned and experiment corpora.
